purpose: Identity facts only (listing venue, symbol, name, quote currency and unit) for the Portfolio Rebalancer's sample holdings, with the source that supports each fact. This file contains NO prices or other market data. Quotes always come from a market-data provider at the time of use.

evidenceLevels.confirmed: Stated by the issuer or the listing exchange.
evidenceLevels.secondary: Stated by a regulator filing summary, an aggregator or news source; not yet checked against the issuer or exchange.
evidenceLevels.audit: Checked in the 2026-11-03 engineering audit (Appendix B, ticker identity) against the sources listed there.

US.name: US exchange (NYSE, Nasdaq, NYSE Arca or Cboe BZX)
US.currencyRule: Securities listed on US national exchanges are quoted in US dollars.

XTSE.name: Toronto Stock Exchange
XTSE.currencyRule: Most TSX listings trade in CAD, but some units trade in USD (for example '.U' lines), so the currency must be confirmed per listing.

NEOE.name: Cboe Canada (formerly NEO Exchange)
NEOE.note: Some brokers display Cboe Canada listings with a '.TO' suffix. That does not make them TSX listings.

XLON.name: London Stock Exchange
XLON.currencyRule: LSE equities are normally quoted in pence (GBX / GBp = 1/100 GBP); some ETFs and international lines quote in GBP, USD or EUR.

XSHG.name: Shanghai Stock Exchange
XSHG.currencyRule: A-shares trade in CNY (onshore renminbi), not CNH.

XHKG.name: Hong Kong Stock Exchange
XHKG.currencyRule: Most counters trade in HKD; dual-counter RMB lines exist.
